audits.caveat: FAISS HNSW does not widen the beam to k: exploration stops after efSearch below-threshold distances even though the result heap holds max(efSearch, k). Recall@k for k > efSearch is therefore bounded by efSearch (storage survey probe, synthetic d=64 N=3000 M=32: recall@300 = 0.925 at efSearch=64 vs 1.0 at 300). Audit at the production candidate k (hybrid_ranker candidate_k >= 100, vector_search asks top_k*3 >= 300) plus tombstone fetch_k, not only k=10.
